description: Get a fresh look at Code Exit in this trailer for the upcoming co-op sci-fi survival horror game. description: Blacksmith Master gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a version 1.0 release date. Check out the latest Blacksmith Master trailer for this simulation game. Forge everything from weapons and armor to tools and cooking utensils to fund your craft and become the Blacksmith Master. Blacksmith Master is out now in early access, and version 1.0 will be available on Steam, Epic Games store, GOG, and Xbox on PC on November 19, 2026.
